verdict.rationale: PagerDuty's first-party developer site documents an interactive OpenAPI reference covering its public APIs, with endpoints, schemas and code samples, and lets users try requests directly from the docs. A try-it console is also listed for SCIM, and the OpenAPI schemas are published and importable into Postman. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the try-it console and runnable examples work as described.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: Browse every PagerDuty public API — endpoints, schemas, and code samples — and try requests directly from the docs.
